examples.en: He can leave anytime he wants.
examples.zh: 他可以在任何他想要的时间离开。

examples.en: We have a standing invitation to visit them anytime.
examples.zh: 他们邀请我们随时去他们家作客。

examples.en: The college admits students anytime during the year.
examples.zh: 这所学院在全年里任何时间都接收学生。

words: in season and out of season
